fairClauses.title: Balanced Notice Period
fairClauses.text: Either party may terminate employment by giving 30 to 60 days written notice or payment in lieu of notice.

fairClauses.title: Reasonable Non-Compete / Non-Solicit
fairClauses.text: Non-solicitation of clients and employees is limited to 6 months post-employment. Post-employment non-compete is restricted to actual conflict of interest.

fairClauses.title: No Unreasonable Training Bonds
fairClauses.text: Employment is at-will post probation without arbitrary financial penalties or training bond recovery deductions.
